import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter, deque

def comps(g, val):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==val and (r,c) not in seen:
                q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft(); comp.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and g[a][b]==val and (a,b) not in seen:
                            seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    objs=comps(g, None if False else next(v for v,c in cnt.items() if c<max(cnt.values()))) # placeholder
    # objects = components of non-bg colors merged? treat all non-bg cells as objects collectively (any non-bg)
    objset={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg}
    comps_=[ [p for p in cs if p in objset] for cs in comps(g, None)]
    # merge components of different non-bg colors that touch
    used=set(); final=[]
    for comp in comps_:
        st=[comp]; new=[]
        while st:
            cur=st.pop()
            if any(p in used for p in cur): continue
            compset=set(cur); merged=True
            while merged:
                merged=False
                for p in list(compset):
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=p[0]+dx,p[1]+dy
                        if (a,b) in objset and (a,b) not in compset:
                            compset.add((a,b)); st.append([(a,b)] if False else [(a,b)])
                            merged=True
            used|=compset; final.append(list(compset))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for comp in final:
        rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; ls=[c for _,c in comp]
        # bounding box; determine nearest vertical edge
        L,R=min(ls),max(ls); distL=L; distR=w-1-R
        if distL<=distR and distR==0: continue  # touches right edge
        if distR<distL: dirn=-1  # nearest right -> extend left? no: extend toward FAR edge => left means dir -1
        else: dirn=1
        if distL==distR: continue
        src=R if dirn==-1 else L
        step=-1 if dirn==-1 else 1
        c = src+step
        # paint bg cells until hitting object or edge
        while 0<=c<w and g[r_ ][c]==bg:
            pass
        # try each row containing object cells? ray should extend along rows? For multi-row objects, ray from bounding-box side
        # simpler: ray from each object cell on the side column, extending outward
        for (r_,_) in comp:
            cc = src+step if r_ in [min(rs for _ in [])] else None
        # simpler: extend from each cell of the side column
        side_cells=[p for p in comp if p[1]==src]
        for (r_,cc_) in side_cells:
            c = src+step
            while 0<=c<w and g[r_][c]==bg:
                out[r_][c]=1; c+=step
    return out

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Collect all changed cells per demo
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    i=np.array(G[k+' input']); o=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    ch=[(r,c,int(i[r][c])) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
    print('====',k,'changed:',ch)
